title: MPP over MCP: a paid tool call
summary: Over JSON-RPC the challenge arrives as error -32042 with request as a native JSON object; the client retries tools/call with the credential in _meta, and the result carries the receipt in _meta.
specVersion: draft-payment-transport-mcp-00 (undated, repository text of 2026-04-16, unchanged at commit 50309c8)

steps.label: tools/call premium-analysis
steps.detail: A normal tool call with no payment data.

steps.label: error -32042 Payment Required
steps.detail: error.data holds httpStatus 402, the challenges array and an optional problem object. Each challenge carries request as plain JSON in the payment method's schema, here a Tempo charge with a TIP-20 currency and a recipient.

steps.label: Retry with _meta org.paymentauth/credential
steps.detail: The credential is a JSON object under params._meta; servers check both root and nested _meta.

failures.outcome: error -32043 with a fresh challenge and a failure object.

steps.label: Result with _meta org.paymentauth/receipt
steps.detail: The tool result carries the receipt object.
